# OpenLine

> Python library for overhead transmission lines: line impedance and admittance, conductor
> ampacity, sag and tension, with a catalog of conductors and structures from standards and
> manufacturers' documents.

Install with `pip install openline`, for Python 3.12 to 3.14; `openline[propagation]` adds NumPy
and SciPy for wave propagation. Calculations take a conductor's construction, its materials and
its standard alone. The catalog is Python: each conductor and structure is a constant, such as
`openline.conductors.astm.b232.DRAKE`, and the validation compares what openline calculates with
what manufacturers and standards report.

## Docs

- [Start here](https://openline.readthedocs.io/en/latest/): installation and a first calculation
- [Conductor properties](https://openline.readthedocs.io/en/latest/examples/conductors/index.html): looking up, comparing and choosing conductors; resistance, sag and tension
- [Thermal ratings](https://openline.readthedocs.io/en/latest/examples/ratings/index.html): ampacity and conductor temperature, IEEE 738
- [Line parameters](https://openline.readthedocs.io/en/latest/examples/lines/index.html): impedance and admittance of lines, bundles and towers
- [Frequency response](https://openline.readthedocs.io/en/latest/examples/emt/index.html): earth return and propagation
- [API: common](https://openline.readthedocs.io/en/latest/api/common/index.html): conductors, structures, materials, units, lines and the catalog lookup
- [API: electrical](https://openline.readthedocs.io/en/latest/api/electrical/index.html): series impedance, shunt admittance and ratings
- [API: mechanical](https://openline.readthedocs.io/en/latest/api/mechanical/index.html): mass, strength and sag

## Catalog

- [Conductors](https://openline.readthedocs.io/en/latest/conductors/index.html): a page per design, by family and standard
- [Structures](https://openline.readthedocs.io/en/latest/structures/index.html): towers, poles and frames
- [Conductors as Python](https://github.com/BirchfieldResearchGroup/openline/tree/main/src/openline/conductors): every conductor the catalog lists
- [Structures as Python](https://github.com/BirchfieldResearchGroup/openline/tree/main/src/openline/structures): every structure the catalog lists

## Optional

- [Validation](https://openline.readthedocs.io/en/latest/development/validation.html): how near openline's calculations come to reported values
- [References](https://openline.readthedocs.io/en/latest/development/references.html): the documents the catalog is drawn from
